items.hint: Finish the main story. Anything you do before the checklist appears already counts.
items.name: Story completion

items.hint: Optional tasks show as black icons with pink letters and purple map markers. There are 200-300 of them, so this comes free.
items.name: Optional tasks completed

items.hint: Clear out every key valuable at each yellow-icon location. A missed valuable respawns after a while.
items.name: Gang operations cleared

items.hint: Opens after Credit Check in Chapter 3. Small banks: cash drawer plus safe. Large banks: the vault too.
items.name: Bank jobs fully completed

items.hint: Opens after Credit Check in Chapter 3. Threaten the teller, take the cash, then rob the backroom safe.
items.name: Payday loan jobs fully completed

items.hint: Pawn shops open in Chapter 2, jewellery stores in Chapter 3. Always loot the backroom safe as well.
items.name: Smash 'N' Grabs fully completed

items.hint: Aim a gun at staff in convenience, fast-food and liquor stores. 91 are tracked and any 50 count.
items.name: Stick ups fully completed

items.hint: Sell stolen narcotics to any fence. It happens naturally while you rob gang operations.
items.name: Narcotics fenced

items.hint: Sell jewellery taken from jewellery stores to any fence.
items.name: Jewellery fenced

items.hint: Sell marked bills from banks and payday loans. Yasmani pays best, and one large bank can pay $205,000.
items.name: Marked bills fenced

items.hint: Follow a security van to a large bank and slip in while the vault is open. Bring your partner to carry a bag.
items.name: Bank vaults hit

items.hint: Sell cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn or at a Pay 'n' Spray. Cars from Randy's Wish List pay $35,000 or more each.
items.name: Vehicles fenced

items.hint: Kenton's treasure-diving sets, marked by purple chest icons. Only 5 of 7 sets count here, but the underwater discoveries need all of them.
items.name: Kenton sets completed

items.hint: 18 sets and 480 cards in total. Track them in Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards.
items.name: Collectible card sets found

items.hint: Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags with the WAiNK phone app.
items.name: WAiNK locations scanned

items.hint: Sunken shipwrecks, part of Kenton's questline. Track them in Progress, Collections, Exploration.
items.name: Underwater discoveries found

items.hint: 27 magazines plus 7 book swaps make 34 unique items. Duplicates do not count twice.
items.name: Magazines, books & comics found

items.hint: 18 spots in 10 locations. With Jason and Lucia together each counts twice. The Chapter 1 balcony meditation is separate — see the Missables tab.
items.name: Meditation spots completed

items.hint: Destroy the pink flamingo lawn ornaments. 125 exist and any 100 count.
items.name: Cocaine flamingos destroyed

items.hint: Finish both unique in-game playlists.
items.name: Unique playlists completed

items.hint: Discover clothing styles. 79 exist and any 70 count.
items.name: Styles discovered

items.hint: Win 30 different unique races out of 40.
items.name: Unique races won

items.hint: Take gold in 10 of the 13 race challenges.
items.name: Race challenge gold medals

items.hint: Gold at all 42 challenges across the 12 shooting ranges.
items.name: Shooting range gold medals

items.hint: Play all 4 video games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck.
items.name: Video games played

items.hint: Beat 5 of the 7 pool opponents.
items.name: Pool opponents defeated

items.hint: Play mini golf at 2 of the 3 locations.
items.name: Mini golf locations played

items.hint: Sink baskets at 90 of the 100 hoops around Leonida.
items.name: Basketball hoops

items.hint: Finish all 42 drone time trials at the 14 Top Fun locations.
items.name: Drone time trials completed

items.hint: Any 300 of 397: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
items.name: Stunts completed

items.hint: Complete any 70 of the 80 challenges. You can skip the hardest 10.
items.name: Challenges completed

items.hint: Bret's 15 hunting Target Decks, as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required.
items.name: Bret's Target Decks

items.hint: Scan any 200 of the 277 base models with the WAiNK app. Boats and aircraft count too.
items.name: Base model vehicles scanned

items.hint: Find 50 of the 66 standard-issue weapons: 53 guns, 9 melee weapons and 4 explosives.
items.name: Standard issue weapons found

items.hint: Study animals through the binoculars. You do not need to hunt them, and every breed of dog and cat counts separately.
items.name: Animals studied

note: The 100% checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion only after the story, but progress made before already counts. Nothing on it is missable. Source: PowerPyx 100% Completion Checklist & Guide, 18 Nov 2026.
